profile_text.body:
Resemble AI is a technology company focused on multimodal deepfake detection and media watermarking for enterprise customers. The company describes itself as providing real-time detection of AI-generated audio, video, and images, with results it characterizes as explainable and suitable for compliance purposes. Its detection product, called DETECT-World, combines pattern matching and training with a world model architecture designed to recognize deviations from physical reality. The platform is available either on-premises or via cloud deployment.

The company's held facts note that Resemble AI also has a voice cloning product, which the site tracks under the Voice and Audio category with a notation around likeness and consent risk. This positions the company on both sides of the synthetic media landscape, developing tools that generate voice content as well as tools intended to detect and verify AI-generated content. The company describes its broader mission as bridging the gap between AI creation tools and the trust and transparency needed to use them responsibly.

The site's content incorporates a range of news items illustrating the harms associated with deepfake technology more broadly, including fraud cases, non-consensual synthetic imagery, and impersonation scams, presented as context for the cybersecurity problem Resemble AI says it is addressing. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the held data for this company.
